title.narrative: Beitrag zu einer gleichberechtigten Gesellschaft durch Förderung des Dialogs
Contributing to an equal society by promoting dialogue

description.narrative: Das Projekt zur Entwicklung einer gleichberechtigten und gerechten jüdisch-palästinensischen Gesellschaft in Israel bei. The project aims to develop an equal and just Jewish-Palestinian society in Israel. Palestinian and Jewish young adults engage in social activities for an equal and just society in their communities and address various forms of discrimination, some of which cut across groups. By focusing on working with young adults, the aim is to bring about a long-term change in attitudes and critically question existing narratives and discourses regarding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
